span.class: fa fa-gear fa-2x rounded-circle bg-primary s_features_grid_icon

div.p: Participating programs enjoy a centralized portal to effortlessly manage student placements, contracts, and offers, all tailored to meet the specific needs of each program. The platform also facilitates one-click matching of students based on predetermined criteria.

div.class: col-lg-12 pt16 pb16 o_colored_level o_animate o_animate_on_scroll o_anim_fade_in

span.class: fa fa-sitemap fa-2x rounded-circle bg-primary s_features_grid_icon

div.p: Clinical sites benefit from a dedicated portal to submit availability to preferred programs, approve or decline assigned students based on optimal matches, request additional documentation, and add more locations, SCCEs, or CIs. Clin Ed TREE adapts to the unique processes of each program or clinical site, bringing consistency to diverse practices.

div.class: col-lg-12 pt16 pb16 o_colored_level o_anim_fade_in o_animate o_animate_on_scroll

span.class: fa fa-drivers-license fa-2x rounded bg-secondary s_features_grid_icon

div.p: Empowering students, the portal enables them to manage placement preferences, accommodation or hardship requests, site requirements, and medical needs. Students receive real-time updates on the progress of their submissions and placement status from initial preferences to the completion of their clinical experience.

div.class: col-lg-12 pt16 pb16 o_colored_level o_animate o_animate_on_scroll o_anim_fade_in

span.class: fa fa-file-text-o fa-2x rounded bg-secondary s_features_grid_icon o_we_force_no_transition

div.p: Clin Ed TREE now includes a customizable reporting feature tailored to each program's needs. This feature supports accreditation requirements and analytical purposes, providing valuable insights for continuous improvement.
